quality_codes.0: Computed from valid, non-placeholder source footprint
quality_codes.1: Invalid or placeholder geometry; distances/bands/masks/intersection bits are null

bands_m2_sparse.value: [0–5m area, 5–10m area, 10–20m area] in square meters outside footprint
bands_m2_sparse.absent_key: all three computed areas round to zero; this is a geometry result, not a safety or coverage determination

contract.outline_intersects_bits: Bit i is source geometry intersects footprint for layer_order[i]. Distances may round to 0 near a boundary; use this separate bit to identify actual topological contact.
contract.nearest_distance_search: Global nearest original full-resolution category polygon. No search-radius cap. Rounded to0.001m for storage, recommend <1m/whole-meter display; not source accuracy.
contract.band_distance_units: meters, using EPSG:2263 with US survey foot =1200/3937 meters

fingerprint.rounding: Every x/y becomes Math.round(value*1e7); preserve type, ring/component/vertex order; discard Z; no spaces in JSON
fingerprint.validation: Compare geometry fingerprint and source edit date before using derived record; mismatch or missing record is unknown, never zero.

contract.band_geometry: EPSG:2263 buffers at5,10,20m,32segments/quadrant; subtract footprint or preceding buffer. Maximum circular approximation error~6mm at20m. Band is a geometric region outside the chosen outline; it may contain other structures/private land.
contract.critical_limit: Official2021 modeling describes buildings as voids in the2D mesh. Blank interior is not evidence of low risk. Areas/distances are surrounding-map context, not indoor depth, entrance/route accessibility, annual probability or expected loss.

model_void_source.finding: Buildings are represented as voids in2D mesh; blank interior cannot establish low flood risk.

transport.identity_note: Existing bytes and sha256 fields identify the unchanged decoded JSON. compressed_bytes and compressed_sha256 identify the deployed gzip file. Historical gzip_bytes fields are level-6 estimates, not the actual level-9 files.
transport.delivery_note: Browser lazily fetches one gzip file and decompresses it before parsing; metadata and method text remain uncompressed. No citywide archive is loaded in a Worker.
